text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While I was discussing today's training menu with King Halo—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Owwooww!! That hurt, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After slamming her own head into the desk,
King Halo is getting angry all on her own.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you've got it wrong!
I was just practicing headbutts!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
More importantly! What are we doing
for today's training, huh?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Um... Where were we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems I ended up dozing off partway through
after all."
choice_data_list: Has fatigue been building up, by any chance?
Has fatigue been building up, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez, there's no need to worry like that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I did try amping up
my self-training routine a bit, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Still, giving up over something like this would make me second-rate!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how bitter or painful it gets, I will overcome it
and grow! Ohohoho!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "If you're my Trainer, you should understand, right? Come on, let's head to training!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Today's King will surpass yesterday's King!
Time to run my heart out and grow!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, what kind of training are we doing today?
I know you mentioned it, but tell me one more time!
choice_data_list: Let's take a nap on the grass!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I told you,
this little bit of fatigue is nothing.
choice_data_list: Come on, just come with me for a sec.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Just when I was getting
focused...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're saying I should just lie down and take a nap here?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well, even if I don't take a nap,
it still seems relaxing enough."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We'll get back to training after a short rest, alright?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Lying down like this and looking up at the sky
isn't half bad, hehe..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Khhh... khhh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-I wasn't sleeping!
I was just taking an extended relaxation break!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow's training is going to be intense!
Including what we missed today!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to a good night's sleep, King Halo was brimming with energy and motivation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? Didn't you say anyone who whines
from being this tired is second-rate!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate lady never gives up
and always moves forward, no matter how tough the situation!
choice_data_list: Come on, just give it a try first.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*, whatever.
If it's not enough, I'll just train on my own.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I can't... Even though this was supposed to be
a lighter routine than usual... my body won't move...
choice_data_list: For you as you are now, this much is enough.
For you as you are now, this much is enough.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Grrr...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: O-Ohohoho! I would appreciate it if you did not get the wrong idea!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"This was a test! Yes, a test!
To see if you'd push your Umamusume too far!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Giving me training tailored to where I am right now...
Not bad at all, you get a passing grade!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho!
Well then, that wraps it up for today!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*, I just want to rest soon...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed lighter training was more than enough
for King Halo right now.
